items.title: Gemini 3 Flash: frontier intelligence built for speed
items.summary: Gemini 3 Flash offers frontier intelligence built for speed at a fraction of the cost.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind正式发布Gemini 3 Flash模型，旨在提供兼具前沿智能与极高响应速度的解决方案。该模型通过优化推理架构，在保持Pro级推理能力的同时，大幅降低了延迟与计算成本。Gemini 3 Flash已集成至Google搜索、Gemini应用及开发者API中，支持多模态理解与复杂任务处理，是Google在高效能模型领域的重要布局。

aiReview.reasonZh: Google发布了Gemini 3 Flash模型，强调速度与成本优势，是主流模型生态的重要更新。

items.title: Introducing OpenAI Academy for News Organizations
items.summary: OpenAI is launching the OpenAI Academy for News Organizations, a new learning hub built with the American Journalism Project and The Lenfest Institute to help newsrooms use AI effectively. The Academy offers training, practical use cases, and responsible-use guidance to support journalists, editors, and publishers as they adopt AI in their reporting and operations.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI联合美国新闻项目及Lenfest研究所共同推出“OpenAI新闻机构学院”。该项目旨在为新闻从业者提供AI技术培训、实践案例分享及负责任的AI使用指南，帮助新闻机构在采编流程中有效整合大模型技术，提升报道效率与质量。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI通过行业学院形式推动AI在新闻领域的落地，具有行业应用示范意义。

items.title: Developers can now submit apps to ChatGPT
items.summary: Developers can now submit apps for review and publication in ChatGPT, with approved apps appearing in a new in-product directory for easy discovery. Updated tools, guidelines, and the Apps SDK help developers build powerful chat-native experiences that bring real-world actions into ChatGPT.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式允许开发者提交应用至ChatGPT平台，并提供全新的应用目录以供用户发现。此次更新包含升级的工具、开发指南及Apps SDK，旨在支持开发者构建具备实时操作能力的聊天原生应用。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI开放ChatGPT应用提交，标志着其生态系统向应用商店模式的进一步演进。
